title: Design exercise: SAA-1.3-S05
scenario: Quillfeather Publishing keeps 14 TB of manuscripts and cover art in S3 in one Region, plus a relational database and a shared file system holding editorial work. A contractor's script deleted a season of drafts last quarter and nobody noticed for three weeks. Leadership now requires at least 99.99 percent of new uploads available in a second Region within 15 minutes, the 14 TB already stored to be present there too, and editors to be able to roll the database and file system back to any day in the last 35 days. Operations wants one schedule and one place to check, not a script per service.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Operations wants a single policy that selects resources by tag rather than one script per service
Finance requires backups older than 35 days to expire automatically
Leadership requires recovery from a deletion noticed three weeks late

rubric.label: The 15-minute ceiling for 99.99 percent of new uploads is met and the existing 14 TB is also covered
Recovery within the 35-day window does not depend on the live second-Region copy

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
